body:
Kevin: Planning to run a prod migration to add orders.metadata (jsonb) + a modest backfill. Target window Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC. Expect ~200k rows touched, mostly recent. Need lock time estimate and rollback plan.

Maria: FYI indexes on orders.customer_id exist, so the alter itself should be cheap. Main concern is the UPDATE backfill for older rows.

Dahlia: Can we do: 1) ADD COLUMN NULLABLE with no default, 2) batched UPDATE backfill, 3) set NOT NULL afterwards? That avoids a full table rewrite.

Kevin: Exactly. Proposed plan:
- ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN metadata jsonb NULL (no default)
- Launch batched backfill job (5k rows/min target, checkpointing)
- After backfill, VALIDATE constraints & set NOT NULL
Thoughts?

Sam: Sounds right. Recommend we start with a narrow predicate (updated_at > '2025-01-01') for the first pass to limit impact, then expand. If we need a non-blocking rewrite for anything big, consider gh-ost/pg_repack patterns.

Deploy-bot: deploy starting: r1234 migration-add-orders-metadata on prod - initiated by Kevin - status: queued

Kevin: Also want to pin app release to v2.18.1 during the backfill so writers include metadata field shape. Otherwise risk partial writes.

Maria: Pin is easy. Also plan to reduce worker concurrency to 10 for the duration to keep DB load stable.

Dahlia: Add a short-circuit in the backfill to skip rows that already have metadata set, helps speed.

Deploy-bot: migration r1234: step "add column" complete. duration 4s. brief DDL, no long locks observed.

Infra-bot: Observability rule: tag long queries on orders table (>30s) and notify Oncall.

Oncall: Got it, watching traces. No spikes yet. Keep me posted.

Kevin: Kicking off backfill now (job id bf-731). Abort conditions: DB CPU > 70% or > 5% error rate on writes. Fallback = pause + rollback app pin.

Deploy-bot: backfill bf-731 progress: 22% (45k/200k). ETA ~40m. next checkpoint in 10m.

Maria: If we see locks, we pause the job. We should avoid full rollback unless we detect data corruption.

Dahlia: After full backfill, we'll run the constraint VALIDATE then set NOT NULL. Use VALIDATE CONSTRAINT to avoid table rewrite if possible.

Kevin: Fallback plan (if things go sideways): 1) pause backfill 2) revert app pin to v2.17.9 3) run cleanup sidecar to remove partial meta writes. Communicate to support.

Deploy-bot: backfill bf-731 progress: 53% (106k/200k). DB load 48%.

Sam: Recommend a quick smoke test of core flows at ~70% to detect any serialization or read anomalies.

Kevin: 75% now, ramping down concurrency to 6 to smooth tail.

Deploy-bot: backfill bf-731 complete. 200k rows updated. duration 1h2m. status: success.

Maria: Running constraint validation now.

Dahlia: VALIDATE CONSTRAINT finished. Setting NOT NULL on metadata column.

Deploy-bot: migration r1234 complete. notes: app pin removed (v2.18.1 unpinned). tags: patch/migration.

Oncall: Observability clear. No ongoing locks or long-running queries. Nice work team :tada:

Kevin: Thanks everyone. I'll draft a short release note and post in #announcements tomorrow.
